# Test material (for unit tests only)

Self-signed certificates/keys `test-cert-{a,b}.pem` / `test-key-{a,b}.pem` for the in-process fake hub.
Worthless, not for production use, and not tied to any real hub. Two pairs so that "certificate changed" can be tested.
